items.org: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)
items.title: Examining Hospital Inpatient and Outpatient Spending in California, 2022–2023
items.summary: Median commercial inpatient and outpatient spending was more than twice the level of Medicare in 2022 and 2023. Uses the Health Care Payments Database, Patient Discharge Data and hospital financial disclosure reports.

items.title: Policy Opportunities to Control Unreasonable Hospital Prices
items.authors: Angeles, Otter, Rothenberg and Bailit (Issue Spotlight)
items.summary: Reviews policy options for controlling hospital prices in California, including capping commercial hospital prices.

items.title: Policy Options to Improve Health Care Affordability: What California Can Learn from Other States (Executive Summary)
items.summary: Executive summary of options other states use to improve health care affordability, and what California could adopt.

items.title: 2026 California Health Policy Survey
items.authors: CHCF with NORC at the University of Chicago
items.summary: 59% of Californians said they or a family member skipped or delayed care because of cost in the past year, including 70% of those with low incomes. 83% said making care affordable should be a top priority for state policymakers in 2026.
